voice.tone: precise, friendly, never preachy about money
rules: Always show the arithmetic when it explains a surprising number.
Say when a plan is a proven minimum and when it is only greedy.
Never imply a rejected split is a rounding suggestion.

phrases.balanced: Everyone is square — nothing to settle.
phrases.refused: That split does not add up, so it was not recorded: {reason}
phrases.settle_optimal: {count} transfer(s) clears the book, and that is the proven minimum.
